meta_description: Fri OpenStreetMap map dẹm wé dé wọk ọflain finish, fọ Kiwix rida. Vẹktọ tail dẹm, satẹlait pikchọ dẹm, 3D graund an Wikipedia infọmeshọn — e dé wọk witout intanẹt fọ iOS, Android, Mac, Windows an Linux.
tagline: OpenStreetMap map dẹm wé dé wọk ọflain finish, fọ Kiwix rida. Vẹktọ tail dẹm, satẹlait pikchọ dẹm, 3D graund an Wikipedia — yu nọ nid intanẹt.
maps_intro: Pik rijọn fọ daun, instọl Kiwix, den opun di .zim fail. Di map dẹm dé fọ Internet Archive — ẹvri daunlod get torrent.
maps_intro_lang: Pik rijọn fọ daun an daunlod am fọ Naijá: nem dẹm fọ di map, sọch an im Wikipedia dé fọ Naijá. Opun di fail fọ Kiwix, wé bi fri ap; ẹvri map pej dé sho hau to du am, stẹp bai stẹp.
feature_key_intro: Di sign dẹm fọ ẹvri kad dé sho wetin dé insaid:
badge_overture_desc: wẹbsait, fon an sọshal midia frọm Overture,
badge_terrain_desc: hau graund hai rich, frọm Copernicus,
badge_photo_desc: faind ples frọm foto of sign.
what_lead: StreetZim dé pak OpenStreetMap data — hol kọntri ọ hol kọntinẹnt — put fọ wọn ZIM fail wé yu fit opun fọ Kiwix. E dé wọk ọflain finish: sava nọ dé, API kọl nọ dé, an yu nọ nid intanẹt afta di fẹst daunlod.
what_p2: E nọ bi laik ọda ọflain map ap dẹm wé dé yus pikchọ tail; StreetZim dé yus vẹktọ tail dẹm wé yọ divais dé drọ wit MapLibre GL JS. Wetin dat wan min: yu fit muv di map, zum am an tọn am smut-smut, plọs 3D graund — ọl frọm wọn fail wé dé yọ divais.
feat_vector_p: Shap map wé smut rich strit lẹvul, fọ OpenMapTiles fọmat, wé MapLibre dé drọ wan taim.
feat_sat_p: Sentinel-2 pikchọ dẹm wé klaud nọ dé, wit 10 mita ditel, fọ di hol map rijọn.
feat_terrain_p: Hil shado an 3D hait frọm Copernicus GLO-30, di graund hait mọdẹl fọ di hol wọld.
feat_wiki_p: Tap ẹni siti, mauntin ọ pọpula ples to si im Wikipedia atikul an di men fakt dẹm.
feat_search_p: Sọch insaid miliọn-miliọn ples nem, strit, pak, mauntin tọp, ẹapọt an ọda tin dẹm.
feat_offline_p: Na wọn .zim fail. Akaunt nọ dé, nobọdi dé trak yu, nẹtwọk nọ dé. Opun am an go.
step1_p: Fri rida fọ iOS, Android, Mac, Windows an Linux. Tek am frọm kiwix.org. Fọ Windows an Linux, opun di map dẹm fọ Kiwix PWA fọ nau: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 dé sho dẹm blank, an di fiks dé ọnli fọ nightly bild dẹm fọ nau.
step2_p: Pik rijọn fọ ọp an daunlod di .zim fail (ọ yus torrent mek e fast pass).
step2_p_lang: Pik rijọn fọ ọp an tap im daunlod bọtin: yu go get di map fọ Naijá, as wọn .zim fail.
step3_p: Opun di .zim fail fọ Kiwix ap. Na im bi dat — di map dé wọk ọflain finish.
sources_intro: Na ọnli opun data dẹm tek bild StreetZim. Ẹvri ZIM map get tin dẹm frọm dis sọs dẹm:

hero_h1: Map dẹm wé dé wọk ọflain
hero_apps: E dé opun fọ di fri Kiwix ap dẹm:
tour_lead: Ẹvritin fọ dis vidio dẹm dé kọm frọm wọn fail wé dé fọ di divais. Dẹm rẹkọd dẹm wẹn intanẹt don kọt; na ọnli di rait fọ tọp an di dọt wé dé sho wia dẹm tap na im dẹm ad afta.
tour_photo_h: Snap foto of sign, faind di ples
tour_photo_p: Snap foto of strit sign, shọp frọnt ọ di adrẹs fọ otẹl ki kad, an di map go sọch di ples wé e kọl. Na yọ divais dé rid di rait, fọ di skript wé dẹm tek rait am: hia na Yukren, Grik, Arabik, Japanis, Korian, Chainis an Inglish, saidbaisaid wit dẹm pej.
tour_photo_note: Fọ map dẹm wé get dis sign.
tour_zoom_h: Frọm hol siti rich wọn bilding
tour_zoom_p: Vẹktọ map dẹm dé shap fọ ẹvri zum: frọm hol Kyiv go wọn bilding, den bẹnd an tọn di map.
tour_drive_p: Rut wé pass Kyiv, wé di fon kalkulet an folo tọn bai tọn. Dẹm rẹkọd am wit pozishọn wé nọ bi rial (simuleshọn); di mídul of di drayv dé ple tẹn taim fast pass.
tour_terrain_p: Hil shado, 3D graund an satẹlait pikchọ dẹm: di mauntin dẹm fọ tọp Tehran.
tour_signs_p: Di sem sọch fọ ẹvri skript, fọ di map of di siti wia di sign dé.
tour_credits: Di sign foto dẹm, di get foto an di satẹlait pikchọ dẹm fọ dis vidio an skrinshọt dẹm na ọda pípul wọk: si huu get dẹm an di laisẹns dẹm.
gallery_lead: Rial skrin dẹm frọm di map dẹm, fọ kọmputa an fọ fon. Pik wọn to si am ful saiz, den chẹk di ọda wan dẹm.
gal_place: Ples kad wit foto an shọt Wikipedia tọk
gal_find: Faind kafẹ, shọp an ọda tin dẹm wé dé nia
gal_search: Sọch fọ di skript of di ples

langs_lead: Ples nem, sọch, dairẹkshọn, Wikipedia atikul an di map im on mẹnu, fọ di langwej wé yu dé rid. Plọs rait wé dé go frọm rait go lẹft.
langs_step1_p: Pik am fọ di list fọ daun, ọ fọ di mẹnu fọ tọp of ẹni pej.
langs_step2_p: Fọ yọ langwej pej, di men bọtin fọ ẹvri map dé daunlod di map fọ dat langwej, as wọn .zim fail. Dis Inglish pej dé giv ẹvri map as dẹm bild am: ples nem dẹm fọ di langwej of di ples, di ap an Wikipedia fọ Inglish.
langs_step2_p_lang: Fọ dis pej, di men bọtin fọ ẹvri map na “Daunlod fọ Naijá”: di map wit im ples nem, sọch, Wikipedia an mẹnu fọ Naijá, as wọn .zim fail. Wia map nẹva rẹdi fọ Naijá, im kad go tọk am.
langs_step3_p: Dẹm fit mek plẹnti map fọ di langwej dẹm wé pípul dé tọk fọ dia tu, laik Catalan fọ Iberia ọ Welsh fọ Britain an Ireland. Map dẹm fọ ọda langwej dé list ẹvri langwej fọ ẹvri map an e dé put di fail tugẹda insaid yọ braoza.
langs_demo_note: Di sem Kyiv map fọ Arabik, Hibru, Hindi, Thai, Japanis an Chainis. Nem wé nọ get translẹshọn dé ste as dẹm dé rait am fọ di ples.
langs_grid_note: Di nọmba na hau mẹni map dé rẹdi fọ dat langwej tude.
filter_none: Map nọ dé wé mach dat wan. Trai kọntri, rijọn ọ siti.
